scientific_integrity: The result uses a complete analytic proof of a universal lower bound over all correspondences and an explicit optimal upper-bound map. The standalone checker is finite, regression-only evidence. Literature priority remains best-knowledge and subject to independent verification; neither expert nor independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the finite sets of regular m-gon vertices with the inherited shorter-arc metric, and odd integers m >= 5, are covered. Chord distances, polygon-edge intrinsic metrics, arbitrary four-point spaces, and other source orders are outside scope. The m=5 value was known via the consecutive-size theorem. No classification of all optimal correspondences is claimed.
title: Exact Gromov–Hausdorff distances from the geodesic square to every odd regular circle sample
